test_objective: Check that you can retrieve a list of NGSI-LD attributes

test_cases.name: 025_01_01 WithoutJsonLdContext
test_cases.doc: Check that you can retrieve a list of NGSI-LD attributes
test_cases.then:
then {
    the SUT sends a valid Response for the operations:
        Retrieve Attributes with Response Status Code set to 200     and
        Retrieve Attributes with Response Body containing an Attribute List element
            * with filename set to 'types/expectations/attribute-list-025-01-01-expectation.json'
            * response set to '${response.json()}'
}
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/attributes'
        method set to 'GET'
        Retrieve attributes: and
    Query Parameter: context set to '${EMPTY}'
}
